notes.title: Post-Release Hotfix 2: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.notes:
Thanks again to everyone who has supported At Winter’s End — we are so grateful to everyone who has played our game, and are excited to bring it to even more of you! We have a handful of small updates for you, and are excited to announce that [b]At Winter’s End is now officially Steam Deck Compatible![/b] Enjoy!

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue stopping achievements from unlocking on Mac
[*] Tweaked input glyphs and tutorials to be more platform-agnostic
[*] Fixed “Report Issue” button not working on certain devices
[*] Fixed certain menu behavior to no longer be framerate dependent
[/list]

notes.title: At Winter's End Original Soundtrack – Steam Release!
notes.notes:
We are super excited to announce the release of the soundtrack for At Winter’s End, composed by the illustrious Keeper of the Sound, Braden Hajer! The soundtrack is available FOR FREE on Steam as .mp3s as well as high quality .wavs. The soundtrack will also be available on all major music streaming services in a few weeks.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2732110/At_Winters_End_Soundtrack/]At Winter's End Soundtrack[/url]

Thank you so much to everyone who has played and supported At Winter’s End so far, and to all those who will play it in the years to come. We are excited to continue working on exciting new projects and games together!

-Slandercast Studio
🎵 🌱 🦉 ❤️‍🔥 🎵

notes.title: Post-Release Hotfix 1
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone for the support, we're really happy to see you all enjoying At Winter's End! The update today is pretty minor, just fixing a couple of small issues we've noticed.

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Day 3 story branch logic
[*] Fixed an issue with Day 3 achievement unlocks
[*] Tweaked colliders in Capybara's Hollow and Pond
[/list]
